capabilities.title: Local encrypted .kdbx database with AES-256 and ChaCha20 encryption
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeePassXC: KDBX4 format with Argon2 key derivation
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password manager. Running a local encrypted KDBX database is outside product scope.

capabilities.title: Argon2 memory-hard key derivation for master password protection
capabilities.reason: Nexus VAULT stores API keys; Argon2-based key derivation for local credential protection is a security pattern worth adapting.

capabilities.title: YubiKey and TOTP second factor for database unlock
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeePassXC 2FA: YubiKey challenge-response and TOTP built-in
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no hardware key unlock workflow; 2FA for a local database is outside current scope.

capabilities.title: Configurable password generator: length, character sets, wordlist-based passphrases
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeePassXC password generator: full-featured entropy-controlled generation
capabilities.reason: Nexus VAULT could expose a secure password/passphrase generator utility; pending VAULT feature planning.

capabilities.title: Browser extension integration for autofill across websites
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a browser extension and does not perform autofill. Browser integration is out of scope.
